programs.title: Heartland Homicide
programs.desc: On New Year's Eve in Cooperstown N.D., an intoxicated Kurt Johnson is given a ride home from a local bar; when it's discovered that Kurt never arrived home, authorities begin their search, and what they uncover shocks them to their core.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: When Israel Keyes is apprehended in connection to Samantha Koenig's disappearance, police have no idea that it will lead them to a string of other murders; despite promising to help authorities solve other missing persons cases and unsolved murders, Keyes is focused on controlling the narrative in the media about how he is portrayed, and the FBI must bite their tongues and suffer through the ramblings of a serial killer if they hope to find out the truth.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: Lori calls the police after her husband falls overboard during a boating trip on a lake; what starts as a search and rescue operation evolves into something darker as an investigation reveals more information.

programs.title: Seduced by His Lies
programs.desc: Terri returns from an extended trip to find a mysterious yet captivating stranger living in her recently purchased home. Believing they've been scammed, they team up to expose the criminals, only to uncover a chilling labyrinth of lies and deception.

programs.title: Robin Hood
programs.sub_title: Bound by Love, Divided by Lies
programs.desc: The Queen's arrival to Nottingham puts the Sheriff in a bind, back her plans or risk his life to avert war; Marian and Rob share a fleeting reunion, cut short when Marian learns of his role in her brother's death.

programs.title: Stockholm Bloodbath
programs.desc: A ruthless political struggle between Sweden and Denmark turns bloody under the tyranny of the mad King Christian II. Caught up in this deadly war, two sisters seek revenge on the men who brutally murdered their family.

programs.desc: In a quiet Florida neighborhood, police unearth a shallow grave and the truth about a predator's twisted past.
